description: Source code for HR department management and related UI and user hierarchy logic in an OpenERP module.

classes.name: hr_department
classes.description: Model representing organizational departments with hierarchy and members.

classes.name: ir_action_window
classes.description: Extension of window action to dynamically modify domain based on department members.

classes.name: res_users
classes.description: User model extension to compute parent and child user hierarchies.

methods.name: _get_members
methods.description: Retrieve user IDs of department members managed by a specific user.

methods.name: _check_recursion
methods.description: Ensure department hierarchy does not contain recursive loops.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Override to modify domain with department members in window actions.

methods.name: _parent_compute
methods.description: Compute parent users for a given user based on department membership.

methods.name: _child_compute
methods.description: Compute child users for a given user based on department management.

methods.name: _parent_search
methods.description: Search domain for parent users based on computed hierarchy.
